home.titleA: A good website doesn't draw attention to itself.
home.lede: My name is Raf. I build websites for shops, restaurants and tradespeople. Fast, readable, and easy for you to update yourself.

items.q: People can't find you on Google.
items.r: Your opening hours, address and services are written where search engines read them. The site is fast and properly structured, which matters for ranking.

items.q: Bookings still come in by phone.
items.r: A booking or appointment page takes requests for you, including outside opening hours.

items.q: Your site exists, but nobody dares touch it anymore.
items.r: I take over the existing site, fix what no longer works and hand the texts and photos back to you.

proof.title: What it looks like in practice
proof.note: These two sites were built end to end to show the method. There is no client behind them.

steps.title: Listening
steps.text: A first half-hour conversation to understand your business, your customers and what you are missing. Free, no commitment.

steps.title: Quote
steps.text: Together we settle the pages, the texts, the photos and who provides what. You receive a written quote that states what is included.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: The site is built in visible stages. You follow progress on a private address and react as it takes shape.

steps.title: Checks
steps.text: Every page is tested on phones, on desktop, on a slow connection and with typing mistakes in the forms.

steps.title: Launch
steps.text: Domain name, hosting and backups are set up. I remain available after delivery.

contact.title: Describe your business and what you need.
contact.text: Three lines are enough to start. I reply within two working days.

services.title: What you can entrust to me
services.lede: Four kinds of work, from a showcase website to taking over an existing site. For each one, what is included is written down.

offers.title: A website for your business
offers.text: Showcase site, online shop, reservations or appointment booking. I handle design, build and launch. You can then edit texts and photos yourself.
included: Domain name and hosting set up

offers.title: A tool that fits the way you work
offers.text: Scheduling, quotes, order tracking, client area. When off-the-shelf software doesn't match how you operate, I build the tool around your organisation.

offers.title: Your tools talking to each other
offers.text: The booking that fills the calendar, the order that produces the invoice. Information flows without retyping.
included: Written diagram of what goes where

offers.title: An existing site to put right
offers.text: Slow, broken or impossible to edit. I write up an assessment, fix what needs fixing and modernise without starting over.

pricing.title: How I quote
items: A first half-hour conversation, free of charge.
A written quote covering the whole project.
The quote states what is included and what is not.
pricing.faqA: There is no public price list: a three-page site and an online shop do not cost the same. After a first conversation you receive a written quote, before any commitment.

cta.title: Have a project in mind?
cta.text: Describe your business and what you need. I tell you what is possible, in what timeframe, and send you a quote.

work.title: Two sample projects

work.note: Sample projects built by R-X. No real client behind these screens.

projects.name: Showcase website with booking
projects.need: Be found online, show the pieces and take workshop bookings, without depending on someone for every update.
projects.delivered: A fast site, editable without technical skills, with a booking page and careful search engine optimisation.

projects.name: Online appointment booking
projects.need: Appointments taken without answering the phone mid-service, and an up-to-date calendar.
projects.delivered: Available slots online, a confirmation sent to the customer, a calendar that fills itself.

cta.title: Your project in their place?
cta.text: Describe your business. I reply within two working days.

about.title: A developer, not an agency
about.lede: My name is Raf. I am an independent web developer based in the Gers, in south-west France. The person reading your message is the one who builds your site.

who.title: How I work
who.p1: I take care of the whole project: understanding the need, choosing the technology, building, checking, launching and maintaining. You explain your project once, decisions are quick and answers are direct.
who.p2: I favour sites that are simple to maintain: few external components, justified technical choices, pages that load fast. More work at the start, far fewer problems later.

steps.client: You describe your business and your need.
You follow progress on a private address.
You try the site and report what is wrong.
You receive the access details and the site's code.

items.title: Restraint
items.text: Every component added must serve the project. Whatever adds weight without purpose is removed.

items.title: Verification
items.text: Every page is checked on phones, on desktop and on a slow connection before going live. The code is versioned and backed up.

items.title: Transparency
items.text: A written quote before starting, and immediate notice if anything changes the schedule.

cta.title: A question about your current site?
cta.text: Send me its address. I tell you what I see: speed, readability, what needs attention.

faq.a: With a free conversation of about thirty minutes, by phone or video call. You describe your business and your need, then I send you a written proposal.
There is no public price list: a three-page site and an online shop do not cost the same. After a first conversation you receive a written quote, before any commitment.
Two to eight weeks depending on the scope. The timeline is stated in the proposal. If something unexpected changes the schedule, you are informed immediately.

faq.q: Who provides the texts and photos?
faq.a: You, as a rule: nobody knows your business better than you. I proofread the texts and tell you what is missing. If you have no photos, we discuss it from the start.
Yes. I am based in the Gers and work with clients across France and beyond. Regular video calls and a demo version available at all times.
You receive the access details and the site's code, with a hands-on session for everyday updates. Ongoing maintenance can be quoted separately.
